mapper.select: SELECT FILE_ATCH_POSBL_AT AS fileAtchPosblAt, ATCH_POSBL_FILE_NUMBER AS posblAtchFileNumber, IFNULL(ATCH_POSBL_FILE_SIZE, 0) AS posblAtchFileSize FROM COMTNBBSMASTER WHERE BBS_ID = #{bbsId} AND USE_AT = 'Y'
SELECT NTT_ID AS nttId, ATCH_FILE_ID AS atchFileId FROM COMTNBBS WHERE BBS_ID = #{bbsId} AND NTT_ID = #{nttId} AND USE_AT = 'Y' FOR UPDATE
